about_the_game:
Jester Party is an exciting 2–6 player co-op card game that blends horror and suspense.
Your goal is simple: play your cards silently in ascending order and trust your instincts completely — no turn order! Cooperate with your team.

But beware! If any player holds a card lower than the one on the table, you lose a life. Wrong moves throw the table into chaos, trigger terrifying events, and turn the party into a nightmare. You can also punish the player who makes a wrong move.

🎮 Gameplay

  • 2–6 players play their cards without following a set turn order, relying solely on intuition.

  • Ascending Rule applies: each new card must be higher than the previous one.

  • No Hints: Talking, signaling your next move, or giving advice is strictly forbidden.

  • Wrong moves can lead to life loss or cursed penalties.

  • If you play all cards correctly, you advance to the next level at the end of the round.

  • The game features 12 terrifying levels, each with more cards and higher risks.

🃏 Why Play?

  • Different Modes: You can scare the player who endangers the team by playing a wrong card, or play without any horror elements… and much more. Choose the mode you want.

  • Silent Cooperation: Work seamlessly with your team, relying solely on your instincts.

  • Horror & Suspense: Wrong moves unleash eerie animations and sound effects that keep you on edge.

  • Chaotic Fun: Experience a creepy yet hilarious jester-themed party.
